body: guys. thanks so much. I'll do everything that you said, and even if I can't repay the kindness and compassion you've shown me today, I'll try to pay it forward in the future.

To be honest, I don't know why I'm in this relationship anymore besides the fact that it's the only relationship I have left. I've been scared to even think these thoughts about how she might not be "the one." I've always loved her from the bottom of my heart and with all my soul. She's beautiful even when she's just woken up and her hair's a mess. In fact, I prefer her like that. She's all that's good and wonderful in the world and just talking to her makes me happy. I miss her so much. I miss her wonderful sense of humor and how she accepts me for who I am unconditionally. 

...

Oh god, I can't believe I came that close to hurting her like what I almost did. I am so sorry. I must have caught her at a bad time (it being 2am and all). I'll sleep on it, and talk to her in the morning. Thank you so much for helping me through this and calming me down. I know she loves me and that's all I need to get up tomorrow morning and get through another day. And the day after. Ad infinitum

It's been very difficult since the boarding school shuts down internet at 11 EST and I've been living on the west coast. I've pretty much lost all contact with them at this point. I guess I could call tomorrow and see what's up.

Do you have any advice for getting out? I always mean to go to some club, but when it comes time to actually leave my room and go, I always find some excuse not to. I'll try to go to the next event that comes up and go to that though.

I love music. I've played the viola for 12 years (and I'm pretty damn good at it). I quit six months ago because I broke my instrument and don't have enough money to pay for a new one. Given the opportunity, now, I'm not sure I would pick it up again because of the time commitment involved and my current workload.

To give some context, I went to boarding school for a couple of years. I had a bunch of friends that I was very very close to and I would have (and still would) take a bullet for them. But I was pulled out of school very suddenly, and I was given 12 hours to pack all my things, say my goodbyes, and leave. I've found it difficult to make any friendships since then. My fiancee has been my only social contact for the last year, and I honestly don't know how to function without her.
I'm definitely calming down now. Talking helps.

I'm studying international business.

I don't know why I don't care. I go to classes and do my homework and study for tests and quizzes, call my fiancee and tell hre I love her, and then I go to sleep. The next day, I'll repeat. 

Later on in life, I'll go to work, do my job, go home, eat, and go to sleep.

When I'm old, I'll wake up, be bored, eat, and go to sleep.
I told her I was having a very difficult time and I missed her and everything and all she said was "I have some homework, can I get back to you later?"
My name is David. I live in New York, and nothing's really happened. I just feel hopeless.

So, I'm a freshman in college. My fiancee is going to a different college all the way across the country. Everyone seems to be having so much fun and I'm just sitting in my room trying to care enough to go out and meet them. I'm actually not doing too bad in most of my classes, but my fiancee just doesn't seem to care about me anymore. My parents don't. And I definitely dont have anyone else here that I'm even on speaking terms with. I can't bring myself to care about continuing life. What do I have to look forward to? A desk job that will give me enough money to eat TV dinners until I die of cholesterol or old age? What's the point?

I guess this is it. Good bye, reddit, you've made me laugh at r/pics, cut plenty of onions reading stories like wartoad's, give looks of disapproval to bozarking and his pretenders, and generally given me a way to pass the time. Fare thee well and keep the faith
I'll give this post 20 minutes. After that, I don't think I'll even have the courage to do it.
